# Chart.js

`chart.umd.min.js` is the unmodified standalone browser distribution from the npm package `chart.js@4.5.1`. It is used for canvas charts on the Performance page and served with the site.

- Project: https://www.chartjs.org/
- Source: https://github.com/chartjs/Chart.js
